description: Full interior refurbishment including formation of a new external opening and installation of glazed double doors, bespoke joinery throughout, recessed downlights to the second and third floor ceilings, landscaping works to rear garden including new trellis to party walls, new partitions to the 3rd floor and thin screening constructed of light weight/ translucent metal framed & glass to lift lobbies and powder rooms, replacement of non-original principal entrance hall stairwell, reinstatement of arch detail to canted bay window landing & new wall panelling to stair hall and lift lobbies, new arch detail to lift lobbies to ground and first floors, new double opening to ground and single opening to first floor from the new entrance hall stairwell, replacement of non original mosaic flooring extension in entrance hall, new skirtings, architraves, doors, over panels and associated moulding to all rooms ground to fourth floors, reinstated decorative plaster window surrounds to principal rooms bay windows, replacement of ground floor cornice to match existing first floor, new decorative ceiling and wall panelling to the principal rooms in the ground and first floor. Raise head height of rear second floor outrigger window back to its original size. New asphalt finishes to balconies to first floor and third floor, local strengthening to balustrade to the rear stairwell, with stabilising rod, new parquet flooring and plywood subfloors to front and rear principal rooms, from ground to fourth floor including cable duct style recessed floor boxes, two new fireplaces and hearths to replace non original to the ground floor, new service throughout including replacement AC, replacement of the existing lead flat roofs and flashings with like for like lead coverings, replacement cast iron rainwater goods to rear elevation, lift car fit-out and replacement of lift landing doors and threshold strips, new planters to front metal railings at street level. (Linked to 26/04887/LBC)
